description: Expanded evaluation suite with difficulty tiers (easy/medium/hard) and 10 domain-agnostic question types. Questions target the Romanian Penal Code (test.pdf). Types are generic and apply to any corpus.

questions.question: Ce prevede articolul 170 din Codul Penal?
questions.notes: Direct article lookup — retrieval should return article 170 (reabilitare) at top rank.

questions.question: Ce prevede articolul 228 din Codul Penal?
questions.notes: Direct article lookup for theft definition.

questions.question: Ce sanctioneaza articolul 188 din Codul Penal?
questions.notes: Direct article lookup — murder (omor) definition.

questions.question: articolul 170
questions.notes: Pure keyword/number lookup. Lexical strategy should rank this first.

questions.question: Art. 193 lovirea sau alte violente
questions.notes: Exact phrase retrieval — article 193 on assault.

questions.question: articolul 228 furt
questions.notes: Article number + keyword co-occurrence for theft.

questions.question: Cum este pedepsita uciderea unei persoane?
questions.notes: Semantic mapping — killing maps to omor/ucidere.

questions.question: Care sunt pedepsele pentru furt calificat?
questions.notes: Concept retrieval for qualified theft penalties.

questions.question: Rezuma capitolul despre infractiuni contra patrimoniului
questions.notes: Chapter-level summary query — benefits from summaries index.

questions.question: Prezinta pe scurt prevederile despre infractiuni contra persoanei
questions.notes: Summary-level query over crimes against the person chapter.

questions.question: Ce conditii trebuie indeplinite pentru a beneficia de reabilitare judecatoreasca?
questions.notes: Single-hop but requires reading the conditions inside the article, not just finding it.

questions.question: Care este diferenta dintre tentativa si infractiunea consumata in Codul Penal roman?
questions.notes: Requires connecting articles on attempt vs completed offense.

questions.question: Cum se combina furtul calificat cu circumstantele agravante in aplicarea pedepsei?
questions.notes: Multi-article reasoning across qualified theft + aggravating circumstances.

questions.question: Care este diferenta intre furt si talharie?
questions.notes: Comparison — should retrieve both concepts and contrast them.

questions.question: Care este diferenta intre omor si ucidere din culpa?
questions.notes: Comparison between intentional and negligent killing.

questions.question: Ce fapte NU constituie infractiune conform Codului Penal?
questions.notes: Negation — requires understanding what is excluded from the criminal category.

questions.question: Ce modificari ale Codului Penal au intrat in vigoare in 2014?
questions.notes: Temporal / date-filtered retrieval. Tests ability to surface dated provisions.

questions.question: Care este diferenta juridica dintre culpa cu prevedere si culpa fara prevedere?
questions.notes: Disambiguation between two sub-variants of negligence — similar terms, different legal meanings.

questions.question: Cum influenteaza starea de minoritate raspunderea penala a faptuitorului?
questions.notes: Bridge: connects minority status article to criminal liability article.

questions.question: Ce se intampla daca fur si bat o persoana in acelasi timp?
questions.notes: Semantic mapping — theft+violence maps to robbery (talharie).

questions.question: Cum se calculeaza pedeapsa pentru concursul de infractiuni cand una dintre infractiuni este omor calificat?
questions.notes: Hard multi-hop: concursul de infractiuni rules + omor calificat penalties must be combined.

questions.question: In ce conditii legitima aparare exclude raspunderea penala si cum difera de excesul scuzabil?
questions.notes: Hard multi-hop: self-defense articles + excess of self-defense articles.

questions.question: Cum se raporteaza circumstantele atenuante la reducerea pedepsei minime prevazute de lege?
questions.notes: Bridge: attenuating circumstances article connects to sentencing rules article.

questions.question: Care este legatura dintre reabilitare si stergerea antecedentelor penale?
questions.notes: Bridge: rehabilitation article links to criminal record erasure provisions.

questions.question: In ce situatii tentativa NU este pedepsibila conform Codului Penal?
questions.notes: Hard negation: must find carve-outs and exceptions for punishability of attempt.

questions.question: Ce tipuri de infractiuni nu pot fi savarsite din culpa?
questions.notes: Hard negation: requires understanding of intent-only offenses vs negligence-capable offenses.

questions.question: Care este diferenta dintre talharie si piraterie in Codul Penal?
questions.notes: Disambiguation: two similarly-structured property offenses with violence.

questions.question: Compara regimul sanctionator al furtului simplu cu cel al furtului calificat
questions.notes: Hard comparison: requires retrieving both articles and comparing penalty ranges.

questions.question: What changes to the Romanian Penal Code regarding theft (furt) were introduced after 2010?
questions.notes: Mixed Romanian+English for cross-lingual robustness test. Hard temporal filter.

questions.question: Provide a summary of the Romanian Penal Code provisions on rehabilitation (reabilitare)
questions.notes: Mixed Romanian+English summary query. Tests cross-lingual semantic understanding.

questions.question: Ce prevede Codul Penal despre pedeapsa inchisorii pentru omor?
questions.notes: Single hop on murder sentencing — needs the specific penalty article.

questions.question: circumstante agravante art
questions.notes: Exact lexical search for aggravating circumstances article references.

questions.question: What are the legal consequences when a person kills another in defense of a third party?
questions.notes: English conceptual query — tests cross-lingual concept mapping to self-defense provisions.
